title: Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2610.00545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $\zeta {\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underline\alpha(\zeta)=\tfrac12-(1-2\zeta)_+^2/[2(3-2\zeta)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $\beta_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $\zeta=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. translated_title: 在线非单调DR-次模最大化的几何相关界
translated_abstract: 我们研究在紧凸下闭集上对非负、非单调DR-次模函数的对抗性在线最大化问题。学习者在观测到目标值之前必须先提交每一步动作，并与事后最优的固定动作竞争。我们证明了一个对比较器一致的一阶不等式，得到系数4/9，改进了此前在线0.401的基准，每轮仅需一次梯度查询和一次投影，期望近似遗憾为O(√T)。若 ζ1 ∈ K ⊆ [0,1]^d，系数可进一步改进为 α̲(ζ) = 1/2 − (1−2ζ)₊²/[2(3−2ζ)²]。证明采用直接的有序坐标论证，并构造了一个与目标无关的理性行动。反之，一个三组对称间隙构造给出了ζ=0时的离线预言机上界 β* = 0.470438681380894...，即使拥有精确函数值和完整梯度响应该上界依然成立。此外还包括一个参数化扩展及精确有限实例界……
tldr: 该论文为在线非单调DR-次模最大化证明了系数4/9的一阶遗憾界（改进此前0.401的基准），给出依赖于集合几何的更优系数，并通过对称间隙构造建立了离线预言机上界β*≈0.4704。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a first-order regret bound with coefficient 4/9 for online non-monotone DR-submodular maximization (improving the prior 0.401 benchmark), derives geometry-dependent improved coefficients, and establishes an offline oracle upper bound β* ≈ 0.4704 via a symmetry-gap construction.
